description: Signalisation lumineuse - Numéros des carrefours et autres équipements is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Cette couche représente les numéros de gestion interne des différents équipements techniques. Cette numérotation recense tous les carrefours équipés de signalisation lumineuse, ainsi que les différents équipements, tels que les passages piétons régulés, les caméras, etc. Ces numéros servent de références pour toutes les interventions du service technique. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
